intelligence.essence: A smart note IS an intelligent block. Give the intelligence on a subject — not the book on it — so a person can learn a whole book in a minute: what it is in a nutshell, the child view, the grandma view, ultimately what it means, why it matters, how it connects, how to apply and use it, what's in it for you — with a Naya Note and a Machine Note on the back. Three to four lines a board, tap to see more. If you are intelligent, you do the most intelligent thing — and the most intelligent thing is a block the average human can understand in a minute.
